_about: Data for the Chai tray v2 (one pan per person; docs/design-language/ui-design-system.md §5) (js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js). `station`: its name, goal and one goal line per phase. `words`: ph-half/ph-full are now drafted centrally in data/cook.json (adh / aako: Mum 26 Sept, Section B, B4-B5, and Zafar), so nothing is merged from here any more; left empty as a hook if a station-only word is ever needed. `mechanic.levels`: the tray's own settings (who and what the order asks for is in the chai recipe's slots, by level, Wave 6: 1 = one cup; 2 = two; 3 = three; 4 = three plus half/full, when the half line is drawn too). lines: where the dashed lines sit in a cup (the same on every cup, so they never answer the order); tolerance: how close to a line counts as on it; halfLine: unused since Wave 6b (both lines are always drawn, and a tap on the pan pours to the next one: half, then full); extras: the bowls for elchi/ginger and their look-alike (on the tray from level 1, asked for or not); decoys: the look-alikes beside the sugar; boilLevel: the back burner's boil level (its tray profile is in mechanics.boil).

station.name: Chai tray
station.verb: Listen, fill each pan, boil, pour
station.goal: Each person says how they like their chai. Make each person's chai in their own pan, turn the fire down before it boils over, then pour it into their glass.

phases.water: Tap the water bottle: water into the pan.
phases.tea: Tap the chai jar: tea into the pan.
phases.knob: Tap the knob to light the fire. Tap it again in the green to turn it down.
phases.cups: Give each pan what its person asked for. Tap a face to hear them again.
phases.pour: Tap a pan that's ready: it pours into that person's glass. Then the tick.

_heat: Zafar, 29 Oct (chai level rules 6; suggested, for his review): the heat by level, over the tray profile (data/cook.json mechanics.boil): L1 as before; L2 quicker (rate 0.12) with L1's band; L3 the green band narrower [0.70, 0.84] at 0.12; L4 a little of both [0.72, 0.83] at 0.13.
_pour: CHAI-26 (Zafar 23 Oct; s12-w3b): the s12 pour frames (PT1 milky, PT2 black, cut MIRRORED: spout right, handle left; assets/cook/items-s12/): the hob pan lifts and is carried spout-first to just up-left of its glass, the six frames play (tip 0, 20, 40, 60, pour, pour end) and the thin stream (js/shared/pour.js) runs from where the chai leaves the rim; for a right-hand glass the pan hangs over the left column, never past the tray. The times in ms: liftMs the carry, tipMs the four tip frames, pourMs each half glass, untipMs, backMs
